sections.description:
SPECIAL PROCEDURE FOR SPINNING INDUSTRY RULES, 1999
SPECIAL PROCEDURE FOR SPINNING INDUSTRY RULES, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part II, 2nd July, 1999]
S.R.O. 805(1)/99, dated 1‑7‑1999.‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 71 of the Sales Tax Act, 1990 the
Federal Government is pleased to make the following rules, namely:‑‑‑
1. Short title, application and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) These Rules may be called Special
Procedure for Spinning Industry Rules, 1999.
2. These shall apply to the
spinners and spinning factories manufacturing and producing cotton yarn and
blended yarn falling under Chapters 52 and 55 of the First Schedule to the
Customs Act, 1969 (IV of 1969).
3. They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑‑-(1) In these Rules, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑‑
(a) "Act" means the Sales Tax Act, 1990
(b) "spinning" means
the process of manufacture or production of cotton or blended yarn.
(c) "spinning unit"
means a manufacturing or production unit engaged in spinning; and
(d) "spinner" means a
person who is engaged in the manufacture and supply of cotton yarn or blended
yarn.
(2) The words ‑and
expressions used, but not defined herein, shall have the meaning assigned to
them in the Act.
3. Registration. ‑‑‑(I)
A spinner shall apply for registration, if not already registered, to the
Collector of Sales Tax having jurisdiction in the area where the spinning unit
is situated.
(2) Where a spinner is running
more than one spinning unit or composite unit dealing in ginning, spinning,
weaving, knitting together or is engaged in other taxable activity as
wholesaler, dealer or stockist located outside the premises of the spinning
unit, such spinner shall apply for registration separately for each such
taxable activity.
(3) The application for registration
shall be processed and, if the application contains necessary particulars, a
certificate of registration indicating the registration number assigned to the
applicant shall be issued.
4. Tax rate.‑‑‑All
supplies made by a spinner shall be charged to rates specified in the Act:
Provided that where any such
supply is subsequently exported, it shall be zero‑rated in accordance
with the provisions of section 10 of the Act.
5. Tax invoice.‑‑‑(1)
The spinner shall issue a tax invoice on the supply of taxable goods under
section 23 of the Act.
(2) The spinner shall give
delivery of the yarn to the buyer after issue of tax invoice. The proper
officer of central excise in the premises shall also enter the sales tax
invoice number in the central excise gate‑pass.
6. Tax Returns.‑‑‑The
spinner shall file his tax returns on the prescribed forms in the prescribed
manner and by the prescribed date under the Act.
7. All provisions of the Sales
Tax Act, 1990, and the rules made thereunder, in so far as these are not
repugnant to the context, shall, mutatis mutandis, apply to the spinners under
these rules.
